protocol.selection: Earliest valid one-second constant-label track per source and label; ties by entity. No inference-based selection.
protocol.primary_rq1: Repeated new Qwen timestamp errors on jointly answered timestamps while both MUSIQ and BRISQUE improve.
protocol.secondary: Majority answers, single-metric improvement, coverage gains/losses and detector errors.
protocol.rq2: Compare fixed quality, confidence and disagreement risk rankings; AUROC undefined without both harmful and non-harmful candidates. No learned assessor claimed.
protocol.rq3: Frozen deterministic guards vs captured-only and restored-only: errors, coverage, and common-answered comparisons. No novel framework claimed.
protocol.rq4: Source transfer and two restoration families, same Qwen model and one synthetic degradation severity; not full generalization validation.
protocol.investment_screen: Support focused method development only if at least one new source shows repeatable primary harm and at least one track shows repeatable correction of a captured Qwen error. Otherwise do not launch full framework experiments from this pilot.
protocol.scope: New to paired Qwen test, not untouched sources in the broader project. Same dataset. Preserve all selected cases and negative outcomes.
